privacy.summary: Switches a projector on or off and picks its input, over your network or a serial cable. Installing makes every serial port on the player writable by anyone.

systemChanges.what: makes every serial and console port on the player writable by any program or user; undone by a restart, not by uninstall
writes its PROJECTOR-* command scripts into the player's scripts folder; kept after uninstall

privacy.other: The projector password is saved and written to the plugin's log in plain words and stays on the player after uninstall; the password box is hidden and passwords do not actually work. Every command and the projector's replies are logged.
